steps.sql: CREATE TABLE p0_month_end_shift (id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, at DATETIME, d DATE) ENGINE=InnoDB
SELECT id, DATE_ADD(at, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS shifted FROM p0_month_end_shift ORDER BY id
